instruction: Miget/provider-owner ACL baselines can leave a public `SECURITY INVOKER` RPC executable by `service_role` while stripping EXECUTE from a nested private helper. The normal scheduler then fires successfully but the RPC fails before leasing a row. Every NEW/UPGRADE release must run role-specific private-helper verifiers after final repeatables; the email outbox requires `24082026_1721_miget_private_helper_service_acl_verification.sql`. Miget's generated owner cannot `SET ROLE service_role`, so release verification must use effective privilege catalog checks and runtime PostgREST/cron proof. Do not broaden the repair to `anon` or `authenticated`.
